newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO'S BLANCO SAYS JULY INFLATION 0.86-0.87 PCT.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO'S BLANCO SAYS JULY INFLATION 0.86-0.87 PCT.

text.p: Mexican Trade Minister Herminio Blanco said Thursday that July inflation will be 0.86-0.87 percent.

"Inflation is going down. We now have posted three months of inflation below one percent (per month). In July this year, inflation will come in at 0.86-0.87 percent," Blanco told radio network Radio Red in an interview.

Mexico's central bank is scheduled to post July inflation numbers later Thursday. Blanco's estimate is slightly below that expected in a Reuters survey, which anticipates July inflation at 0.88 percent. June inflation was 0.89 percent.
